# PR #3706: Patch (part 4 of 6): loops that composite: every infinite animation moves only transform and opacity

Closes #3608

Every `infinite` animation in `apps/web/src` now moves only `transform` and `opacity`. A new test guards that, with an empty allow-list.

## What changed

- **Glow and pulse loops.** The glow, shadow or tint is drawn once on a pseudo-element, invisible at rest, and the loop animates only that layer's `opacity`. This covers:
  - the ready and condition glows on cards in hand (`highlights.css`)
  - the Mythic hand shimmer (`cards.css`)
  - the End turn pulse (`board.css`)
  - the two clock pill pulses (`clock.css`)
  - the lane-pick breath (`lanePick.css`)
  - the Duos portal flash (`duos.css`)
  - the coach ring (`tutorial.css`)
- **Face-down card.** The breath keeps only `scale` on the card, and its brightening becomes a pale `::before` layer whose opacity rises and falls with it (`facedown.css`).
- **Veil hatch.** The hatch is a layer one 28px tile wider than the card, sliding by `translateX`.
- **Skeleton.** The skeleton sheen is a band sliding across each block (`skeleton.css`).
- **Dashed arrows.** A path can't be moved by transform, so `DragLayer.tsx` and `OpponentAim.tsx` now render four copies of the shaft (`data-phase` 0 to 3). Each is shown for a quarter of the loop, so the dots hop in 7px steps every 175ms instead of gliding.
- **Kept as they were.** Selector conditions, `--anim-scale` durations and the reduced-motion rules. The 2px ring in `highlights.css` is unchanged.
- **Guard.** `apps/web/src/compositor-loops.test.ts` reads every stylesheet and fails on an infinite loop over `box-shadow`, `filter`, `backdrop-filter`, `background-position` (and `-x`/`-y`), `stroke-dashoffset`, `clip-path` or `text-shadow`. It has a test for each property, the longhand and layered forms, the allow-list, and a sweep of all sheets. Run against the old `highlights.css`, `drag.css` and `skeleton.css`, it failed naming `glow-breathe-ready`, `glow-breathe-condition`, `drag-arrow-march` and `skeleton-shimmer`.
- **Spec.** `spec/rulings/R3608000.md` and `spec/pending/3608.md`.

## Tests run

- `pnpm exec vitest run --project web` over the whole suite, `fx/` included: 710 of 711 files passed on the first run. The failure was `surfaces.test.ts`; after the fix it and the other targeted files passed.
- Targeted: `compositor-loops`, `motion`, `backrow-suspense`, `Clock`, `Skeleton`, `foil`, `aim`, `drag-layer` and `surfaces` all pass.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint on the touched files: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`, `patches check` and `classify --claims`: ok. `cargo fmt --check` printed nothing, and `apps/web/src/wire` is unchanged. No crate was touched, so I did not run clippy or the cargo tests.
- I checked the result in a headless browser (`/dev/hotseat`).
  - A ready hand card has an unchanged ring first layer and `glow-breathe-ready` running on its `::before`.
  - End turn in the waiting state runs its pulse on `::after`.
  - I forced the face-down, veiled and Mythic states by editing the DOM and read the computed styles, which are as intended. I did not play a real face-down card, because no trap was playable in the hotseat decks.
  - The skeleton and the two dashed arrows were not checked in the browser.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Hand glow.** The ring and the 10px outer halo on the card stay at their rest value. `.card` clips its children, so only an inner rim can breathe, and it sits inside the border. I rejected an outer halo on `.hand-slot` or `.zone`, because `.zone` already uses both its pseudo-elements and field cards have no wrapper.
- **Face-down overlay.** I added `:not([data-animating])` to the overlay's selector, so a face-down card being destroyed keeps the burn front's `::before`. The plan's selector would have overridden it.
- **Skeleton blocks.** Blocks are now `position: relative` so the sheen can clip, which would have painted them over the JackiOh mark. I added `isolation: isolate` on `.skeleton` and `z-index: var(--z-content)` on the mark. I used the token because a bare `z-index: 1` raised the sheet's count in `surfaces.test.ts`.
- **Surface count.** I lowered `duos/duos.css` from 23 to 22 in `UNTOKENED_SURFACES`, since the rewrite dropped a keyframe shadow.
- **Guard scope.** The sweep concatenates all stylesheets, since a keyframes name is global. The new keyframes assertions in `backrow-suspense.test.tsx` are titled `R2111000`, so R3608000's `proven_in` lists only the guard.
- **Dashed arrows.** I made four phase copies rather than allow-listing the two loops, which keeps the guard's list empty. The drag arrow sits inside an SVG filter group, so it still repaints; this change is for consistency, not speed.
- **Audits, no edits.**
  - All 22 `will-change` rules in `cosmetics.css` hold their `animation:` in the same rule, so none is held at rest.
  - There are 27 one-shot `filter` keyframes in `animations.css`, not 28. Their `brightness`/`sepia`/`saturate`/`grayscale` mixes can't be reproduced by an opacity overlay, so I left them alone. A follow-up is the place to convert any.

## Look twice

- **Hand glow.** The outer halo no longer breathes; the inner rim does.
- **Glowing card that is also animating.** A ready-glow card that is also `data-animating` now plays its own animation. Before, the glow's animation shorthand won by specificity.
- **End turn.** While waiting, the green ready ring now stays visible under the yellow pulse. Before, the animated shadow replaced it at the peak.
- **Mythic shimmer.** It is a static three-colour rim inside the card, no longer a hue cycle outside the face.
- **Coach ring.** The ring's peak is now the static shadow plus the wide halo, a little brighter than before.

# #3608: Patch (part 4 of 6): loops that composite: every infinite animation moves only transform and opacity
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Part of #3604. An animation on `box-shadow`, `filter`, `background-position`, `stroke-dashoffset`, `clip-path` or `text-shadow` makes the browser repaint the element every frame. One on `transform` and `opacity` runs on the compositor. 14 `infinite` animations in `apps/web/src` animate paint properties, several on many elements at once:

| Keyframes | File | Property | How many at once |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glow-breathe-ready`, `glow-breathe-condition` | `game/highlights.css` | box-shadow | every playable card in hand |
| `jk-facedown-breathe` | `game/facedown.css` | filter | every face-down card |
| `jk-veil-drift` | `game/facedown.css` | background-position | every face-down card |
| `cf-mythic-hand-shimmer` | `cards/cards.css` | box-shadow | every Mythic in hand |
| `end-turn-ready-pulse` | `game/board.css` | box-shadow | 1 |
| `clock-pill-pulse` (×2) | `game/clock.css` | box-shadow | 1 |
| `lane-pick-breathe` | `game/lanePick.css` | box-shadow | every lane offered |
| `duos-portal-flash` | `duos/duos.css` | box-shadow | 1 |
| `coach-pulse` | `tutorial/tutorial.css` | box-shadow | 1 |
| `skeleton-shimmer` | `skeleton/skeleton.css` | background-position | every skeleton |
| `drag-arrow-march`, `opponent-aim-run` | `game/drag/drag.css`, `game/aim/opponentAim.css` | stroke-dashoffset | 1 |

Rewrite each so the loop moves only `transform` and `opacity`. The usual way: the glow, shadow or tint drawn once on a pseudo-element, whose `opacity` (and `scale`) breathes. Each must look as close to today as the technique allows, and the static first layer the component spec reads (the 2px ring in `highlights.css`) stays as it is. Then add a guard so this doesn't come back. A test in the web's CSS suites (`fx/css.test.ts`, `motion.test.ts` or a new one) parses every stylesheet under `apps/web/src` and fails on an animation with `infinite` iteration whose keyframes set a paint property. Any loop that must stay goes in a named allow-list with its reason.

While there, check the 28 one-shot `filter` keyframes in `game/animations.css`. Move those that run on many elements together during combat (a board-wide hit, a sweep) to opacity over a pre-filtered layer where that is cheap and looks the same. Also check the 22 `will-change` declarations in `cards/cosmetics.css`: a `will-change` held on every face at rest costs a layer each. Keep one only while its animation runs.

### Acceptance

- None of the 14 loops above sets a paint property in its keyframes, and each still runs under the same conditions (existing tests and e2e selectors pass).
- The new CSS test fails on an `infinite` animation over `box-shadow`, `filter`, `background-position`, `stroke-dashoffset`, `clip-path` or `text-shadow` outside the allow-list (with a test proving it catches one).
- Reduced motion and `--anim-scale` behave as before.
- Screenshots of the hand glow, a face-down card and the end-turn button, before and after, in the pull request (`ui-walkthrough`).

Part of #3604
